description:
## [1.12.0](https://github.com/RashKash103/sync-up/compare/v1.11.0...v1.12.0) (2026-11-13)

### ✨ New Features

* Choose what the bottom navigation bar shows ([a01e428](https://github.com/RashKash103/sync-up/commit/a01e42891e0622a71406c0b52ea3b8686217fe9e)), closes [#47](https://github.com/RashKash103/sync-up/issues/47)

patches.name: Add archive links to menus
patches.description: Adds Wayback Machine and archive.today options to the menus behind a post and behind a link.

patches.name: Automatically undelete Imgur media
patches.description: Loads Imgur images and videos that no longer exist from the Wayback Machine.

patches.name: Automatically undelete Reddit content
patches.description: Restores the text of removed posts and comments, and the names of deleted authors, from Project Arctic Shift.

patches.name: Choose what the bottom bar shows
patches.description: Lets each item on the bottom navigation bar — Posts, Actions, Explore and Inbox — be left alone, taken off, or replaced with one of the actions from Sync's own actions sheet, and adds one further button beside them. Covers the navigation rail used in tablet mode as well.

patches.name: Disable Sync for Lemmy bottom sheet
patches.description: Disables the bottom sheet at the startup that asks you to signup to "Sync for Lemmy".

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes the ads shown between posts.

patches.name: Fix /s/ links
patches.description: Opens Reddit's shortened /s/ share links in the app.

patches.name: Fix Imgur links
patches.description: Resolves Imgur links in the app instead of through Sync's proxy, which no longer exists.

patches.name: Fix Redgifs API
patches.description: Fixes loading RedGifs media, which RedGifs otherwise refuses.

patches.name: Fix loading more comments
patches.description: Loads the comments behind a "view more" from the thread instead of the endpoint Reddit stopped answering.

patches.name: Fix opening albums
patches.description: Looks a post up through Reddit's thread endpoint instead of the one Reddit stopped answering, which is what an album is opened by.

patches.name: Fix post thumbnails
patches.description: Fixes loading post thumbnails by correcting their URLs.

patches.name: Fix revealing spoilers
patches.description: Opens a spoiler where it sits when it is tapped, which Sync otherwise answers with "Missing post information".

patches.name: Fix video downloads
patches.description: Fixes a bug in Sync's MPD parser resulting in only the audio-track being saved.

patches.name: Gestures for the video player
patches.description: Double tap a video or GIF to play or pause it rather than zoom, drag sideways to seek, and drag up or down after a double tap for volume.

patches.name: Keep the links in the text of a post
patches.description: Keeps the formatting and links in the body shown under a post, which Sync otherwise discards.

patches.name: Keep transparency in a picture
patches.description: Draws the transparent parts of a picture opened in the viewer as the background behind it rather than as white.

patches.name: Keep your place in a feed
patches.description: Returns a feed to the post you were on rather than to the top, where posts have been cleared out of the cache while you were reading.

patches.name: Load threads whose text contains a dollar sign
patches.description: Stops a thread failing to load when the text in it contains a dollar sign.

patches.name: Lock an account with a PIN
patches.description: Adds a PIN to the Security settings that is asked for when an account is opened and, if you like, when the app is opened, beside or instead of Sync's fingerprint lock.

patches.name: Make an address in a post tappable
patches.description: Draws a bare address in a post's body as a link.

patches.name: Modify login WebView
patches.description: Modify the WebView used for logging into reddit to prevent login issues

patches.name: More actions on the floating button
patches.description: Puts up to four of Sync's own actions beside the feed's floating button.

patches.name: Recover post thumbnails from the archive
patches.description: Loads a post's thumbnail from the Wayback Machine when its Reddit preview has been purged.

patches.name: Redirect Gfycat links to RedGifs
patches.description: Loads Gfycat links from RedGifs, including the autoplaying video Sync asks its own proxy for.

patches.name: Show a hidden profile from the archive
patches.description: Fills in a profile from Project Arctic Shift when Reddit answers with nothing.

patches.name: Show a subreddit's banner on its feed
patches.description: Draws the banner a subreddit sets at the top of its posts, rather than only on its About page.

patches.name: Show media in a comment where it sits
patches.description: Draws a link in a comment as the picture or video it points at rather than as a chip naming where it goes.

patches.name: Show the feed while a post is swiped away
patches.description: Draws the screen behind a post as it is dragged aside, which is otherwise left black.

patches.name: Show videos posted in comments
patches.description: Draws a video posted in a comment in the comment, and plays it when tapped.

patches.name: Spoof client
patches.description: Restores functionality of the app by using custom client ID.

options.description: The Reddit OAuth client ID. Refer to Sync Up documentation for more information on what to put here. It can be left empty and set in the app afterwards, under Settings > Everything else > Sync Up client; the app cannot sign in until one is given in one place or the other.

The Reddit OAuth redirect URI. Refer to Sync Up documentation for more information on what to put here. Default value is RedReader's redirect URI. It can also be changed in the app, under Settings > Everything else > Sync Up client.

The app's user agent. Refer to Sync Up documentation for more information on what to put here. Default value is RedReader's user agent. It can also be changed in the app, under Settings > Everything else > Sync Up client.

What to identify as when uploading a picture to Imgur. Sync's own has run out of its daily allowance, so uploading fails until this is one of your own; refer to Sync Up documentation for how to get one.

patches.name: Stop the toolbar menus closing the app
patches.description: Keeps Sync open when the sort or overflow button in the toolbar is tapped, which closes it on some devices.

patches.name: Translate posts and comments
patches.description: Translates a post or comment where it sits, on this device, through DeepL, or Google Cloud.

patches.name: Unblock Imgur
patches.description: Loads Imgur pictures, videos, and albums another way where Imgur refuses the region, through DuckDuckGo's image proxy, a Rimgo instance, or a proxy of your own. Off until it is turned on under Settings > Redirects.

patches.name: Unlock Sync Ultra
patches.description: Turns on the Sync Ultra features that work on the device alone, and removes the offers to buy it.

patches.name: Use /user/ endpoint
patches.description: Replaces the deprecated /u profile endpoint with /user.
